title: Repository Path Classification Manifest Line
description: One line per Git-tracked path in data/foundation/repository-path-classification/classification-manifest.jsonl. The classification engine (tools/foundation/validate_repository_path_classification.py) is the source of truth; this manifest is a generated snapshot validated by --check.

path.description: Git-tracked repository path, relative to repo root, using forward slashes.

category.description: Exactly one governed category. AUTHORITATIVE_CLAIM_INPUT is restricted to the two CJK master-table prefixes (anti-backflow).

matched_rule.description: Name of the rule that produced the category (for audit traceability).
